payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over all factor triples (i, j, k) of n using nested loops up to cube root and sqrt, compute stolen blocks from dimensions (i+1, j+2, k+2), and track min/max.
payload.rationale: Solution performs exhaustive search over all possible dimensions by enumerating divisor triples, a complete search akin to backtracking without recursion; other subtypes (permutation, bitmask, branch-and-bound, graph DFS) do not match.
